name: @workspace/db-voiceforce
description: Dedicated Prisma Client and Database Schema for Voice Force

scripts.build: node -e "try { require('child_process').execSync('prisma generate', {stdio:'inherit'}); } catch (e) { if (!require('fs').existsSync('./generated/client/index.js')) throw e; console.warn('Note: Prisma engine DLL locked by active node process, using existing generated client.'); }"
